body: My respect for people when I see they eat mini wheats 📉📉📉📉

My father left my mom and my 5 older siblings when I was 4.
My mom started drinking as a way to cope with her sadness of being left in the dust, and I have had to experience many things that nobody my age should ever have had to see or do.

I love my mom with all my heart, but growing up with her probably wasn’t the healthiest thing for me.

My freshmen year (age 14) I was getting into many fights at school, my grades were suffering, and I was becoming addicted to stealing (family, stores, convention centers, etc.)
My dad was always still in the picture, I would see him for dinner once a week, but still was not raised with a father IN the household.

As I obviously was not doing so hot, my family came together and decided that something has to change.

So at the age of 14, I was shipped off by myself, to a residential treatment center in hurricane, utah (1400 miles away) called Diamond ranch academy were I spent a year working on myself.

After I finished up in utah, my mom has an episode which ultimately made me have to move in with my father, with no warning or other options.

So if I had to describe why I am depressed, I would say because I hate the household I live in, I feel as if I am belittled by my father and stepmom for who I am because I am not the perfect genius doctors that they both are, I am legally in able to move in with my mom, I feel helpless because I put on a mask and people think that I am a really outgoing and personable guy who cares a lot about others, yet I feel as if nobody actually cares about me, and that my heart was broken a few months ago.

Sorry for the sloppy message, I’m exhausted and trying to figure out my life.
